name: SK Hynix
day_summary: SK Hynix extended its all-time high streak on the June 18 KOSPI session (KRX closed 06:30 UTC), closing at ₩2,685,000 — a second consecutive ATH after yesterday's ₩2,425,000 record close, representing +10.72% from the prior KOSPI close. The session gapped up to an open of ₩2,521,000 (+4% overnight reaction to the pre-KOSPI catalyst flow) then extended to ₩2,685,000 close, intraday gain of +6.51% from the ₩2,521,000 open. The feared hawkish FOMC reaction never materialized for SK Hynix: foreign selling pressure from DXY crossing 100 (USD/KRW moving toward ₩1,530+) was more than offset by two converging fundamental catalysts. The key new item: SK Hynix confirmed it will begin shipping HBM4E SAMPLES in H2 2026, with mass production targeted for 2027 — a product-generation acceleration analysts had not priced into the consensus target of ₩2,690,000. CNBC confirmed SK Hynix's Q1 2026 results ($52.6T revenue, 72% operating margin) and the HBM shortage narrative continue to underpin the investment thesis. With HBM4E sampling now confirmed for H2 2026, the stock has closed ABOVE the prior 38-analyst consensus average PT of ₩2,690,000 — triggering the PT revision cycle. The July 29 Q2 earnings call will provide the first detailed timeline on the next product cycle — a potential multiple-expansion event.
long_pnl: +10.72% on the KOSPI session (from prior close ₩2,425,000); longs from any entry below the June 17 ATH are deeply in the money; the HBM4E sample announcement is a new fundamental catalyst not previously in sell-side consensus; stock has now exceeded the 38-analyst consensus average PT of ₩2,690,000
short_pnl: third nightmare session — new ATH on positive catalysts and above-average volume; the FOMC FX headwind did not materialize as a sustained selling event; no near-term short catalyst as the HBM4E sampling is additive to the bull thesis; stock is above consensus PT, making short-thesis more expensive to hold

decision.rationale: BUY at HIGH conviction (upgraded from MEDIUM). The conviction upgrade is driven by three confirmed June 18 developments: (1) HBM4E sampling confirmation for H2 2026 — a catalyst not in prior analyst consensus; (2) stock closed at ₩2,685,000, exceeding the 38-analyst consensus average PT of ₩2,690,000 — triggering the sell-side PT revision cycle; (3) +10.72% session on above-average volume despite the DXY crossing 100 post-FOMC, confirming domestic institutional buying overwhelmed foreign FX-driven selling. Prior conviction downgrade from HIGH to MEDIUM was based on FOMC FX headwinds; those materialized (DXY at 100.15, USD/KRW elevated to ~₩1,534) but the stock rallied through them on the new fundamental catalyst. Sizing: hold core long, add on any pullback to ₩2,520,000–₩2,580,000 (new support zone after today's extension). Raise stops to ₩2,407,000 (prior ATH support). July 29 Q2 earnings is the next conviction gate — HBM4E timeline and H2 2026 margin guidance are the next catalyst.
